{{Quote|We've encountered heavy resistance. Sykes, there's a trader village in the swamps. They'll help us, if we can find them.|Captain Kael|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A series of '''skirmishes''' occurred in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] countryside during the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army's]] primary target was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], which [[Capture of Theed/Legends|quickly fell]], and after securing Theed, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] forces began attacking the local countryside to gather the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|native civilians]] into [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps. Two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], had fled Theed in stolen [[STAP-2|speeders]] and engaged a number of Federation [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] which were attacking the local [[Farm/Legends|farmsteads]]. Fleeing from Federation reinforcements, the two Naboo [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] then took [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]] and moved into the swamps to seek assistance from a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|village]]. The village was under attack by [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|Federation gunboats]], so Kael and Sykes engaged the gunboats from the air, and in the process rescued the [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]] the villagers were using to escape. In gratitude, [[Rohan Wayside|the leader]] of the village suggested Kael and Sykes [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|seek]] out a [[Borvo|smuggler]] who could help them [[Attack on disabled base|fight back]] against the Federation invasion army.

==Prelude==
After the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> the [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] were in disarray. With the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Federation Droid Army's]] overwhelming numbers, surviving security forces were ordered to evacuate the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], which had quickly [[Capture of Theed/Legends|fallen]] to Federation forces. Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] had also fled the planet to plead her people's case in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Two members of Naboo's [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], stole Federation [[STAP-2|speeders]] to escape from Theed to the countryside. After securing the city, the Federation forces began preparations to move into the countryside to put down any resistance and gather the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|civilians]] into [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camps.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The battle==
===Countryside===
{{Quote|Hurry up! They're attacking the farmhouses.|Captain Kael, to Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
As Kael and Sykes moved away from Theed, several enemy [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] flying [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] began chasing Kael, who ordered Sykes to take them out. Noticing several more enemy STAPs attacking [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]], the two officers engaged the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces, rescuing a number of local civilians in the process. Sweeping through the rest of the countryside, Kael and Sykes destroyed more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] until reaching a large cluster of houses. The Federation was intent on wiping out the Naboo farmers in the area, but Sykes engaged and destroyed several waves of STAPs. With more droids inbound, the two subsequently fought their way down the road. A Federation [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] blocked their path across a bridge, but Sykes destroyed it using his speeder's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]; he also shot down a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]] flying overhead. The two crossed the bridge, entered a security [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], and commandeered a pair of [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruisers]]. Kael told Sykes of a [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|trading village]] in the nearby swamps that could offer them assistance in their struggle against the Federation [[Army/Legends|Army]]. Taking off, they flew into the swamplands, just before a large Federation force reached the swamps.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===The swamps===
[[File:Bfn_skirmishes.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lieutenant Sykes, traveling through the countryside]]
{{Quote|Permission to engage, Captain?''"<br />"''Permission granted. Just make sure you cover those houseboats.|Lieutenant Gavyn Skyes to Captain Kael, flying over the village|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The Federation forces demanded the surrender of the [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] [[Trading village (Naboo swamps)|village]] and opened fire when the villagers refused. The massacre was already underway when Kael and Sykes reached the [[Unidentified Naboo swamp|swamps]] to locate the village. Upon finding it, the leader of the village, [[Rohan Wayside]], contacted them and informed them of the situation. As the flight leader, Kael granted Sykes permission to engage the droid forces, and the two worked together to save several [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]] from destruction. Wayside then asked them to rescue his best [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Vedd Deviss]], who was currently stuck on the far side of the village. The two soldiers flew on to find Deviss, destroying more droid [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and gunboats with the weapons on their police cruisers. At the end of the village, they engaged [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]], which were in the process of leveling the area. The remaining droids fled when Kael and Sykes took the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] down.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
After Kael and Sykes shot down the bombers, Wayside offered his assistance. Kael responded by telling him of their need of pilots to fly against the Trade Federation forces. Wayside sent Deviss to lead the pair to [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|find]] a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Borvo]], whom he thought could help them. After the pilots rescued Borvo's [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|personal transport]] from Federation forces, the smuggler provided them with vital intelligence in order to [[Attack on disabled base|launch an offensive]] against the Federation Army.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This skirmish comprises the second and third missions appearing in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' and introduces the player to security hangars, where they can change vehicles. In the third mission, during the swamp battle, it is possible to pilot a [[Swamp Speeder (Naboo)|Swamp Speeder]] through the use of cheat codes, but the game will instantly lock up, forcing a restart. The level was designed for the player to use a flyable vehicle.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
